# OksiToys

> Handmade amigurumi crochet toys — ready-made, custom orders and PDF patterns

OksiToys specializes in handmade amigurumi crochet toys. We offer ready-made toys, personalized custom orders, and downloadable crochet PDF patterns. Every toy is crafted with love from high-quality, hypoallergenic velvet yarn.

## Key Offerings
- **Handmade Amigurumi:** Unique, soft companions for children.
- **Custom Orders:** Personalized toys tailored to specific preferences.
- **Crochet Patterns:** Digital PDF guides for fellow crafters.

## Contact & Markets
Based in Poland, shipping primarily to Poland and Ukraine.
